## Setup
```{r init, message = FALSE}
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("Seurat")
library("rlist")
library("cowplot")

pal_discrete_sc <- palette_discrete()[-7]

path <- file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
)

source(file.path(path, "conf.R"))

split.by <- 'Patient'
cell_label <- "cell_type_formatted"

path_fig <- file.path(dirname(getwd()), "vignettes", "figures", "qc_analysis")
```

```{r}
load(file.path(path, "integrated_bcells2.rda"))
seurat[["percent_ribosomal"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat, pattern = "^((RP[LS])|(Rp[ls]))")

seurat$cell_type_formatted <- remove_parenthesis(seurat$cell_subtype)
seurat$cell_subtype_formatted <- keep_parenthesis(seurat$cell_subtype) %>% factor(levels = reorder_celltype(.))
seurat$cell_subtype_formatted2 <- seurat$cell_subtype_formatted

best_resolution <- 0.35
snn_cluster <- paste0(
    assay,
    "_snn_res.",
    best_resolution
)

Idents(seurat) <- seurat[[]][, snn_cluster]

seurat <- subsampling_sc(seurat)
```

## Annotation (1)
```{r}
lim <- 25
tab <- table(seurat$cell_subtype_formatted, seurat$Type)
cell_types_low <- rownames(tab)[apply(tab, 1, function(x) any(x < lim))]

seurat$cell_subtype_formatted2[seurat$cell_subtype_formatted2%in% cell_types_low] <- NA
seurat$cell_subtype_formatted2 <- fct_drop(seurat$cell_subtype_formatted2)

bar_group_ident(
    seurat,
    idents = "cell_subtype_formatted2",
    group.by = "Type"
)

list.map(
  unique(seurat$Type),
  f(i) ~{
  tmp <- seurat
  tmp$Type[seurat$Type != i] <- NA
  plot_dim(
    tmp,
    group.by = "Type",
    label = FALSE, 
    na.value = "grey"
  ) +
    NoLegend() +
    ggtitle(i)
  }
)
```

```{r}
bar_group_ident(
    seurat,
    idents = "cell_subtype_formatted2",
    group.by = split.by
)
```

```{r}
seurat <- subset(seurat, subset = Type == "KO")
seurat$cell_subtype_formatted <-  fct_drop(seurat$cell_subtype_formatted)
seurat$cell_subtype_formatted2 <- fct_drop(seurat$cell_subtype_formatted2)
```

## UMAP
```{r}
plot_dim(
    seurat,
    label = FALSE
)
plot_dim(
    seurat,
    split.by = split.by,
    label = FALSE
) + NoLegend()
```

## QC
```{r, message = FALSE}
p <- plot_feature(seurat, pt.size = .25, c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent_mitochondrial", "percent_ribosomal")) %>%
        list.map(f(x, y, z) ~x + ggtitle(str_clean(z)))
plot_grid(plotlist = p, nrow = 2, ncol = 2, align = "hv")
```

## Cell cycle
```{r, message = FALSE}
plot_dim_cycle(seurat)

Idents(seurat) <- "Phase"
Idents(seurat) %>% 
    cluster_size() %>%
    kable_sc(file = file.path(path_fig, "table_phase.png"))

plot_bar_sc(seurat)
```

## Annotation
### Main cell types
```{r}
Idents(seurat) <- cell_label
plot_bar_sc(seurat)

Idents(seurat) %>% 
    cluster_size() %>% 
    kable_sc(file = file.path(path_fig, "table_cells.png"))

plot_dim_cell(seurat, col = pal_discrete_sc)
```

```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_dim_cell(
    seurat,
    group.by = cell_label,
    split.by = cell_label,
    ncol = 3,
    label = FALSE,
    col = pal_discrete_sc
) + NoLegend()
```

### B cells
```{r, message = FALSE}
b_cell <- subset(seurat, cell_type_formatted == "B cell")
Idents(b_cell) <- "cell_subtype_formatted2"

plot_dim_cell(b_cell, cols = pal_discrete_sc)
```

```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_dim_cell(
    b_cell,
    group.by = "cell_subtype_formatted",
    split.by = "cell_subtype_formatted",
    label = FALSE,
    ncol = 3, 
    cols = rep("black", 100)
) +
    NoLegend()
```

### Cell subtypes
```{r}
Idents(seurat) <- "cell_subtype_formatted"
plot_bar_sc(seurat)

Idents(seurat) %>% 
    cluster_size() %>% 
    kable_sc(file = file.path(path_fig, "table_subcells.png"))

plot_dim_cell(seurat, cols = pal_discrete_sc)
```

```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
Idents(seurat) <- "cell_subtype_formatted2"
plot_dim_cell(
    seurat,
    split.by = "cell_subtype_formatted2",
    label = FALSE,
    ncol = 3, 
    cols = rep("black", 100)
) +
    NoLegend()
```

```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_dim_cell(seurat, cols = pal_discrete_sc)

cell_categories <- seurat$cell_type_formatted %>% unique() %>% na.omit()

list.map(
    cell_categories,
    f(x, y) ~ subset(seurat, cell_type_formatted == x)
    ) %>%
list.map(
    f(x, y, z) ~
        plot_dim(
            x,
            group.by = "cell_subtype_formatted",
            cols = rep(palette_discrete(), 5),
            pt.size = .25
        ) +
        labs(title = z, x = NULL) 
) %>% plot_grid(plotlist = ., align = "hv", nrow = 2)
```

```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 12}
cell_list <- map(cell_categories, ~ {
  seurat$cell_subtype[str_detect(seurat$cell_subtype, paste0("^", .x))] %>% na.omit() %>% keep_parenthesis()
}) %>%
  set_names(cell_categories)

p <- list.map(
  compact(cell_list),
  f(x, y, z) ~ plot_bar_sc(x, z)
)

plot_grid(plotlist = p, align = "hv", nrow = 2)
```
